description: Quantizer clamping a 1V/octave signal to twelfths of a volt, with each of the twelve notes switched in or out of the scale

params.text: Shifts the whole scale in twelfths of a volt, 0 to 12, so that the R note falls somewhere other than a whole volt
Switches that note in and out of the scale; an input landing on a note that is switched out is quantized down to the nearest note left switched in

inputs.text: The 1V/octave signal to be quantized, and its channel count sets the channel count of both outputs

outputs.text: A 10V trigger lasting 15ms each time the quantized note changes

notes: all twelve notes are switched into the scale when the module is added, so the input passes through unchanged until you switch some out.
menu: Major — switches the note switches to a major scale rooted on the note set by R
Natural Minor — switches the note switches to a natural minor scale rooted on the note set by R
Harmonic Minor — switches the note switches to a harmonic minor scale rooted on the note set by R
Whole Tone — switches the note switches to a whole tone scale rooted on the note set by R
